rules.description: Candidate only: shared-IP effects require measurement
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and http.host in {"meet.tuturuuu.com"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")) and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/webhooks/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/cron/")))
